evidence_class: measured cycle model + analytical lower bound (no new synthesis: all unchanged-model query variants fail the Phase-1 synthesis gate)

phase0_measured_query_cycle_model.note: df_attn and finish_token already overlap across queries in the existing query DATAFLOW region.

phase2_lower_bound_analytical.mechanism_needed: key-lane parallelism P>=5..8 over the key dimension (each of the 5 sequential softmax passes traverses SEQ keys) PLUS a >=2.5x finish_token/FFN speedup
phase2_lower_bound_analytical.resource_projection: doubling attention parallelism from the current P=2 (attn2)+4-head+ff4 design already exceeds the 3,311 free LUT; P>=4..8 pushes LUT well beyond the 53,200 device limit. DSP 160/220 and FF 46,839/106,400 have room; LUT is the binding constraint.
phase2_lower_bound_analytical.verdict: B: real-time (<=2,048,000 cycles) is NOT achievable with the unchanged four-class int10 model on xc7z020clg400-1. The query attention region is LUT-bound.

phase1_synthesis_gate_result: No unchanged-model query candidate was synthesized: bit-exact pass-fusion lower bound ~4.6M (>target, fails gate); key-lane 8x is LUT-infeasible (fails resource gate). Per the task, variants whose analytical lower bound exceeds 2,048,000 are rejected before synthesis.

phase3_plan_analytical.authorized_because: Phase 2 concludes unchanged model cannot reach target
phase3_plan_analytical.approach: token aggregation: map the 1024x8 window to fewer transformer tokens (4:1 -> SEQ=256), preserving all 8 channels and the 20.48 ms observation window; retrain the same F_1layer transformer (d_model=32, 4 heads, FFN 64) on aggregated tokens, re-quantize to int10, regenerate golden vectors, evaluate accuracy on the preserved file-level split.
phase3_plan_analytical.SEQ512_note: SEQ=512 (2:1) analytical total ~2.28M (finish-limited) -> marginally OVER target; SEQ=256 recommended.
phase3_plan_analytical.feasibility: GPU (torch cu118, CUDA available), processed dataset (data/processed), and train/quantize/export scripts are present locally.
phase3_plan_analytical.requirements_per_acceptance: retrain (val first, test once), report accuracy/macro-P/R/F1/confusion vs float+int10 references, new weights/scales/golden under a NEW artifact name, native int + Vitis CSim, then C-synthesis interval/resources.
phase3_plan_analytical.status: PLANNED / NOT YET EXECUTED (analytical estimates only; requires a retrain+re-quantize+re-synthesize cycle)

scope_caveat: C-synthesis estimates only; not place-and-route, bitstream, or board results. Nothing committed or pushed.
